disease_label_per_paper: Nontyphoidal Salmonella multiple osteomyelitis in a child with sickle cell anemia
presentation_summary: 2-year-old Black child with sickle cell anemia developed high fever and abdominal pain with body temperature 39 degC.
No cough, expectoration, diarrhea, convulsions, or other associated symptoms were observed at presentation.
Blood culture grew ESBL-producing Salmonella group C; ceftriaxone was changed after susceptibility results.
Subsequent limb pain, left humerus pathologic fracture, MRI/PET findings, and bone tissue culture established multifocal NTS osteomyelitis complicating bacteremia.
